name: find-work-emails
description: Find and verify work emails for a list of people, as a CSV with status and total cost. Runs on Ahel, pay per result.

interface.shortDescription: Work emails for a list of people, verified
interface.longDescription: Give a list of names and company domains. The skill quotes the price, finds each work email through Ahel, verifies it, and returns a CSV with a status per row and the total cost.
defaultPrompt: Find and verify work emails for the people in leads.csv.
Find the work email for Jane Doe at example.com and check it is deliverable.
